hints.title: Chronological Event Ordering
hints.text: Sort all events primarily by timestamp, breaking ties by processing offline status changes before messages.

hints.title: Offline Expiration State
hints.text: Maintain an array indicating the timestamp until which each user remains offline.

hints.title: Mention Token Processing
hints.text: Process all-user and online-user message broadcasts, as well as specific user identifiers.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorts events chronologically with offline priority and updates mention counters per event.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Processing events out of order violates offline duration tracking.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Maintains offline expiration array and mention tallies per user.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Designs simulation with stable multi-key event sorting and stateful status tracking.
